All imaging data were acquired on a 3 T Siemens Trio MRI scanner.

A high-resolution T 1 -weighted anatomical magnetically prepared rapid acquisition gradient echo (MPRAGE) sequence was used (144 slices 1 mm thick, TR = 2.3 s, TE = 4.38 ms, TI = 1200 ms, flip angle = 12°, FOV = 208 × 256 mm, imaging matrix = 208 × 256), yielding 1 mm 3 isotropic voxel resolution.
